items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: There was Billy Kyle on piano... We had worked up at the 845 Club in the Bronx... the man hired Billy Kyle to come in with the band... It was practically the same men

ctx.x: Billy Kyle, that's right. That was the band. Six pieces. And it was a nice picture. It wasn't a bad picture. But it wasn't no house-breaker or anything
